title: The size and layout of Suburban Gardens, a gambling house
summary: Suburban Gardens was a gambling house with a porch around the room and no air conditioning; he compares it with the Roosevelt ballroom and Beverly Club.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene
